title: Porridge
steps: Simmer oats with milk in a small pan for 5–7 minutes, stirring until creamy.
Slice banana and serve on top.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Overnight Oats
steps: Stir oats and yoghurt together with 150 ml milk in a lidded container.
Refrigerate for at least 6 hours; top with washed berries before serving. Do not cook.
notes: Chill covered in the fridge for at least 6 hours. No eggs or cooking required. Keep refrigerated.

title: Scrambled Eggs
steps: Beat eggs with 2 tbsp milk and a pinch of pepper.
Cook gently in a lightly buttered non-stick pan, stirring until softly set and no runny egg remains; scatter with chives.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Breakfast Wrap
steps: Dice tomato and scramble eggs in a non-stick pan until fully set.
Divide eggs and tomato between warmed tortillas, roll up and serve.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: French Toast
steps: Whisk eggs with 100 ml milk and cinnamon.
Dip bread briefly on both sides; fry in a lightly buttered pan for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and egg is fully cooked.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Tomato Soup
steps: Soften chopped onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and stock, simmer 15 minutes and blend until smooth; season and reheat thoroughly.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Vegetable Wrap
steps: Grate carrot and slice any other fresh vegetables.
Spread hummus on tortillas, add vegetables, roll tightly and serve cold.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Jacket Potato
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); prick potatoes and bake 60–75 minutes until tender throughout.
Split open, fluff with a fork and top with grated cheddar and sliced spring onion.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Pasta Salad
steps: Boil pasta in salted water according to packet instructions; drain and cool promptly.
Chop cucumber and tomatoes, mix with pasta and a little olive oil; refrigerate until serving.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Egg Sandwich
steps: Boil eggs for 10–11 minutes, cool in cold water and peel.
Chop eggs, mix with mayonnaise and a little pepper; sandwich between bread slices and refrigerate if not eating immediately.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Cottage Pie
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil peeled potatoes 15–20 minutes and mash with a splash of milk.
Brown beef mince thoroughly in a pan, add finely diced carrot and 200 ml stock, simmer 15 minutes; transfer to dish, top with mash and bake 20–25 minutes until piping hot.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Brown beef mince in a pan, breaking it up, until fully cooked.
Add tinned tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes; boil spaghetti separately following packet instructions and serve with sauce.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Chicken Curry
steps: Cut chicken into small pieces and fry with curry powder in 1 tbsp oil for 3 minutes.
Add 200 ml water and simmer 12–15 minutes until chicken is thoroughly cooked; serve with rice cooked to packet directions.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Vegetable Lasagne
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Slice courgette thinly and soften in a frying pan.
Layer passata, courgette and lasagne sheets in a baking dish, adding 200 ml water to sauce if thick; cover and bake 35–45 minutes until pasta is tender and bubbling.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Fish Pie
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); boil potatoes and mash.
Poach fish gently in 250 ml milk until opaque and flakes easily, place in baking dish with peas, spoon over mash and bake 20–25 minutes until piping hot.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Chickpea Curry
steps: Warm drained chickpeas in coconut milk with curry powder if available for 10 minutes.
Add spinach and simmer 3–5 minutes until wilted and piping hot; serve with rice or bread if desired.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Rinse lentils and simmer in passata plus 250 ml water for 20–25 minutes until soft.
Cook spaghetti separately to packet instructions; season sauce and spoon over pasta.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Stuffed Peppers
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Halve and deseed peppers.
Cook rice according to packet directions, mix with crumbled feta and chopped herbs if available, fill peppers and bake 25–35 minutes until tender.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Vegetable Frittata
steps: Heat oven grill to medium. Dice courgette and pepper and soften in an ovenproof pan with 1 tbsp oil.
Beat eggs, pour over vegetables and cook gently until nearly set; grill briefly until the centre is completely set.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Bean Chilli
steps: Drain and rinse both kinds of beans.
Simmer with tinned tomatoes and a pinch of chilli powder for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally until thick and piping hot.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Victoria Sponge
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan); grease and line two 18 cm cake tins.
Cream butter with 180 g caster sugar, beat in eggs and fold in flour with 2 tbsp milk; bake 20–25 minutes until risen and cooked through. Cool and sandwich with jam if desired.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Chocolate Brownies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan); line a 20 cm square tin.
Melt chocolate and butter gently, whisk 2 eggs with 150 g sugar and fold in chocolate and flour; bake 22–28 minutes until edges are set and centre slightly fudgy. Cool before cutting.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Banana Bread
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan); line a loaf tin.
Mash bananas; whisk with eggs, 80 ml oil and 100 g sugar, fold in flour and 1 tsp baking powder; bake 45–55 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Oat Cookies
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan); line a baking tray.
Cream butter and brown sugar, mix in oats and 100 g flour; form 12 balls, flatten and bake 12–15 minutes until golden at edges.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Blueberry Muffins
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan); line a 12-hole muffin tray.
Mix flour with 80 g sugar and 1 tsp baking powder; stir in milk, 1 egg and 60 ml oil, fold in blueberries and bake 18–22 minutes until cooked through.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Rice Pudding
steps: Heat oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Place pudding rice, milk and sugar in a greased ovenproof dish.
Stir and bake 1–1½ hours, stirring once, until rice is tender and creamy; add more milk if needed.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Fruit Crumble
steps: Heat oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Slice apples into a baking dish with 2 tbsp sugar.
Rub butter into oats with 60 g flour and 50 g sugar, scatter over fruit and bake 30–35 minutes until golden and bubbling.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Chocolate Mousse
steps: Melt chocolate gently and allow to cool slightly.
Whip cream to soft peaks, fold in chocolate and divide into glasses; refrigerate 2 hours until set. No raw eggs are needed.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Baked Apples
steps: Heat oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Core apples without cutting through bases.
Fill cavities with raisins and cinnamon, add a splash of water to dish and bake 25–35 minutes until tender.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Berry Parfait
steps: Wash berries and pat dry.
Layer yoghurt, berries and granola in glasses; serve straight away for crunch or chill without granola until serving.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Hummus
steps: Drain and rinse chickpeas, reserving 2 tbsp liquid.
Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice and a splash of water until smooth; season and refrigerate.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Energy Bites
steps: Soak dates in warm water for 10 minutes if firm; drain.
Blitz dates, oats and peanut butter into a sticky mixture, roll into small balls and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Cheese Scones
steps: Heat oven to 220°C (200°C fan); line a tray.
Mix flour with grated cheddar and 40 g cold butter, add milk gradually to make a soft dough; pat 2 cm thick, cut and bake 12–15 minutes until golden.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); drain and dry chickpeas thoroughly.
Toss with oil and paprika, spread on a tray and roast 25–35 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp; cool slightly.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Fruit Skewers
steps: Wash strawberries and grapes, peel banana and cut into bite-size pieces.
Thread fruit onto skewers, or serve loose for children to avoid sharp sticks and choking hazards.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Carrot Soup
steps: Slice carrots and onion; soften onion in a saucepan with 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Add carrots and stock, simmer 20 minutes until tender and blend smooth; reheat before serving.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Leek Potato Soup
steps: Slice leeks and dice potatoes; wash leeks well.
Soften leeks in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, add potatoes and stock, simmer 20–25 minutes and blend or leave chunky.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Minestrone
steps: Soften mixed vegetables in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, 500 ml water and pasta; simmer 12–15 minutes until pasta and vegetables are tender, stirring often.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Pea Soup
steps: Soften diced onion in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Add peas and stock, simmer 8–10 minutes and blend until smooth; reheat and season.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Butternut Soup
steps: Peel and cube squash, dice onion.
Soften onion in 1 tbsp oil, add squash and stock, simmer 20–25 minutes until tender, then blend.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Garlic Potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); cut potatoes into 2 cm chunks.
Toss with crushed garlic and olive oil; roast 35–45 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Roasted Carrots
steps: Heat oven to 200°C (180°C fan); peel and cut carrots into even batons.
Toss with oil and honey, spread on a tray and roast 25–35 minutes until tender and caramelised.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Herby Rice
steps: Rinse rice thoroughly; bring stock to the boil in a lidded pan.
Add rice, cover and simmer gently according to packet directions until liquid is absorbed; rest 5 minutes and fluff with parsley.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Creamy Mash
steps: Peel and chop potatoes; boil in salted water 15–20 minutes until tender.
Drain well, mash with 30 g butter and enough warmed milk for a creamy consistency; season.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Coleslaw
steps: Finely shred cabbage and grate carrot.
Mix with mayonnaise, season and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Pesto Pasta
steps: Cook pasta following packet instructions, reserving 2 tbsp cooking water.
Drain and toss with pesto, halved cherry tomatoes and reserved water; warm briefly and serve.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Use cooked rice that was chilled promptly and stored refrigerated; do not use rice left at room temperature.
Heat a little oil in a pan, stir-fry rice and peas until steaming hot, add beaten eggs and stir until fully set; serve immediately.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Bean Quesadilla
steps: Drain and rinse beans, lightly mash with a fork.
Spread beans and cheddar on tortillas, fold and toast in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes per side until hot and cheese melts.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Tomato Omelette
steps: Dice tomatoes; beat eggs with a pinch of pepper.
Cook tomatoes briefly in a lightly oiled non-stick pan, add eggs and cook until almost set, sprinkle cheese and fold; ensure egg is fully set.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.

title: Tuna Melt
steps: Drain tuna thoroughly and spread on bread slices.
Top with grated cheddar and grill until cheese is bubbling and bread toasted; serve hot.
notes: Check ingredients for allergens. Follow food-safety guidance, especially for eggs, meat, fish and leftovers.
